pages.title: Superfluid Helium
pages.text: Helium so cold it flows without friction. It climbs the walls of its container in a thin film, leaks through gaps too small for any normal liquid and never stops swirling once set in motion. It is utterly clear and almost weightless in the pipe.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Distilling warm helium in the Fractionation Spire, the bottom tier collected a liquid that crept up the column walls by itself. Below the lambda point, helium-4 had lost all viscosity.
